paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of Llama3 under different answer popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The line graph illustrates the relationship between question popularity and three variables: accuracy, confidence, and alignment, for Llama3-8B on songs. The X-axis, labeled "Question Popularity," has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 160, with evenly spaced numerical labels at intervals of 20. The Y-axis, labeled "Values," is also linear, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0, with labels at intervals of 0.2. The graph contains three distinct lines, each representing one of the variables. 

The blue line, representing "Accuracy," starts at approximately 0.3 when question popularity is around 10 and decreases to roughly 0.2 at a popularity of 20. It then rises to about 0.45 at a popularity of 40, followed by a slight decrease to 0.35 at 60. The line continues to rise to 0.65 at a popularity of 90, peaks at around 0.7 at 100, and subsequently drops to approximately 0.35 at 120. It then gradually increases to around 0.5 at a question popularity of 150. 

The green line, representing "Confidence," begins at approximately 0.8 when question popularity is around 10 and decreases slightly to 0.7 at a popularity of 20. It then rises to around 0.8 at 30 and remains relatively stable, with minor fluctuations, until it reaches a value of approximately 0.9 at a question popularity of 150.

The red line, representing "Alignment," starts at around 0.55 when question popularity is 10 and decreases slightly to approximately 0.5 at a popularity of 20. It then rises to about 0.65 at 40, followed by a slight drop to 0.6 at 60. The line continues relatively stable until it rises to approximately 0.8 at a popularity of 90 and peaks at around 0.85 at 100. Subsequently, it drops to around 0.55 at 120 and then gradually rises to approximately 0.65 at a question popularity of 150.
